merge_queue.max_entries_to_build_reason: each iOS merge group holds two hosted macOS runners and the org shares a 5-job macOS pool with Jovie. Measured 2026-10-13: at 2, merge-group macOS pickup p90 was 15 min; 4 produced 19 and 26 min waits and stalled Jovie's Mac Build within 30 min, and 3 still left Jovie's queue head waiting. Web-only groups skip macOS since #1352 (232s), so raise only when iOS groups need fewer macOS jobs or self-hosted Macs add capacity
merge_queue.check_response_timeout_minutes_reason: GitHub's maximum: the timer must only catch groups whose CI never reports, never eject groups waiting on runner capacity (job timeouts bound runtime)

token_enrollment.reason: merge_group events caused by GITHUB_TOKEN start no CI run; the queue only honours checks from the merge_group event, so the entry must be enqueued by a non-GITHUB_TOKEN identity
